中间是本次行动的层数，每 10 层为一段。标黄的第: The middle shows this operation's floors, in blocks of 10. On the yellow floors
仓管台管理仓库。所有物品共用仓库容量，一格放一件装备或一组材料；仓储部升级会提高: The Depot Desk manages the depot. Every item shares one capacity: a cell holds one piece of gear or one stack of a material, and Storage upgrades raise both the capacity and how much a cell stacks. Click an item to bring it into the pack; drag pack items back to store them.
出发前可以在这里为装备投保。投保的装备若没能带回，罗德岛小队会在 2 到 4 小: Insure gear here before you leave. Insured gear that does not come back is returned by the Rhodes squad 2 to 4 hours later; the premium equals its delivery price. Rhodes standard gear is taken back at the end of a contract and needs no insurance.
右侧是这份合同的详情：地区、掉落和合同目标。选好一项目标后点击最终准备，确认干员: The right shows the contract: region, drops and objectives. Pick an objective, press Final Prep, confirm operator and gear, and you are out. Finish the objective and extract to earn its LMD reward.
外勤队已归舰。带回的物资还在背包里，可以在结算的仓库页一键入库，博士。: The field team is back aboard. What you brought home is still in your pack, Doctor — store it all from the settlement's Depot page.
层会随机出现一个撤离点；第 10 层之后是营地，营地设有固定撤离点，也可以在可露: a random extraction point may appear; after floor 10 comes a camp, with a fixed extraction point and Closure's supplies.
已拆开，物品已入库。: opened; the items are in the depot.
已送回基地仓库。: has been sent back to the base depot.
撤离后背包物品自动入库: Pack items go into the depot after extraction
调度台是出击的地方。在这里选择地区和合同，确认出发准备后即可出击。: The Dispatch Desk is where you sortie. Pick a region and a contract here, confirm departure prep, and you are off.
走到发光的站点旁按 E：调度台接单、后勤柜台投保、仓管台、整备台、医疗前台。: Walk up to a glowing station and press E: Dispatch for contracts, Logistics for insurance, the Depot Desk, the Workbench, the Medical front desk.
企鹅专递单已入库。: The Penguin parcel slip is in the depot.
加工站用材料和龙门币加工成品，按现实时间计时，完成后直接入库。: The workshop turns materials and LMD into goods, in real time; finished goods go straight into the depot.
大宗货箱已入库。: The bulk cargo crate is in the depot.
干员倒下，罗德岛小队已接回博士。安全袋里的物品全部保留；身上和背包里没有投保的物: The operator fell; the Rhodes squad brought the Doctor back. Everything in the Secure Pouch is kept; uninsured items worn or in the pack are lost; insured gear is returned to the depot by the Rhodes squad 2 to 4 hours later. The fallen operator is badly injured and can be treated at the Medical front desk.
罗德岛小队找回了投保的装备，已送回仓库。保险随之用掉，需要的话请在后勤柜台重新投: The Rhodes squad recovered the insured gear and returned it to the depot. The insurance is used up; insure it again at Logistics if you need to.
